description: Agent Healthcare: submit an after-visit summary with the appointment record and the instructions as written: the summary with the visit day, provider, location, each service or procedure with its code and name, each instruction given and each follow-up with whom, within how many days or on which day; optionally the appointment record with its day, provider, location and status (scheduled, completed, cancelled or no show); and optionally the visit record with each service or procedure, each instruction as written and each follow-up. The signed report gives the visit, the appointment with its date and provider read as matching or differing and its status, the services listed and recorded with those the record does not show and those left out, the instructions given and written with those missing from the summary and those the record does not write, and the follow-ups named and recorded with those missing and those with other timing, and counts them, and names a divergent summary: a summary for an appointment the record shows cancelled or missed, a visit date or provider unlike the appointment record, a service the visit record does not show, and an instruction or follow-up the visit record names missing from the summary; then a recorded service left out, an instruction the visit record does not write, a follow-up with other timing and a location unlike the appointment record, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No appointment record, no visit record, a date or provider missing on either side, or a visit record silent on services or instructions the summary gives leaves the summary unverified. Services match by code where both state one, otherwise by name. This reads an after-visit summary against the visit’s own records: wever_claim-evidence-check reads a product or diligence claim against the evidence offered for it, and wever_observability-report-check reads an observability summary written for a principal against its underlying record, while the visit check reads what the patient was given against the appointment and the instructions as written. Verdict health_visit_divergent, health_visit_partial, health_visit_unverified or health_visit_accurate. POST /api/health-visit-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.
